ground_truth.description: The fallback `(load && load[m.key]) || { current: null, sparkline: [] }` only substitutes the default when the whole metric object is missing. If the API returns a metric object present but lacking `sparkline` (or with `sparkline: null`), `datum.sparkline` is passed to <Sparkline> as undefined/null, which could break rendering. A safer access would default the sparkline field itself.

`fetchLoad` is fired on a fixed 5000ms interval with no in-flight guard; if a request takes longer than 5s (slow network/server), multiple overlapping fetches can be issued and complete out of order, potentially showing stale values momentarily. Minor since each response fully replaces state.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
